statement.p: Let C be the counter-clockwise planar circle with center at the origin and radius r > 0. Without computing them, determine for the following vector fields \bf F whether the line integrals \displaystyle \int_C \mathbf F \cdot \, d\mathbf{r} are positive, negative, or zero and type P, N, or Z as appropriate.
A. \bf F = the radial vector field = x\mathbf i + y\mathbf j:
B. \bf F = the circulating vector field = -y\mathbf i + x\mathbf j:
C. \bf F = the circulating vector field = y\mathbf i - x\mathbf j:
D. \bf F = the constant vector field = \bf i + j:
